youtube_description:
Series: Microfilmmaker Talks With...
Interview Subject: John Badham
Number of Interviews: 3
Job: Director
What they're known for: Saturday Night Fever, Wargames, Short Circuit, Stakeout, etc.

Topic:
In this first of a three part interview, director John Badham (Saturday Night Fever, War Games) sits down with Microfilmmaker Magazine to discuss his new book, John Badham on Directing, as well as what got him into directing, his thoughts on industry changes and his approach to directing.

To read the MFM review of John Badham's new book, go to: http://www.microfilmmaker.com/wordpress/2013/09/johnbadrev/

For more information on MicroFilmmaker Magazine, go to: http://www.microfilmmaker.com

"Like" us at Facebook at: http://www.facebook.com/microfilmmakerfan
and
Follow us on Twitter at: http://www.twitter.com/microfilmmaker
youtube_title: MicroFilmmaker talks with John Badham, Part 1: What Sparked Your Interest in Directing??
